overview.text: Recent developments in artificial intelligence highlight major leaps across software verification, cinematic video generation, and agentic foundation models. Claude has demonstrated that large language models can formally prove security properties and uncover long-standing bugs across numerous open-source libraries, scaling formal verification significantly. In video generation, factor-aware predictive learning addresses the complex demands of temporal inference and precise control over actions, scenes, and characters. Meanwhile, new sparse Mixture-of-Experts architectures like IQuest-Q1 are pushing foundation capabilities forward for agentic command-line interface systems. Additional progress includes budget-aware adaptation techniques for extracting signals from diffusion models, novel hierarchical language modeling strategies combining continuous semantic compression with discrete generation, and open releases such as fine-tuned agentic models designed for long-horizon scientific problem solving. Together, these advances reflect a continuous maturation in reasoning, generation quality, and practical developer tooling.

entries.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
entries.summary: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years.
entries.why: Claude successfully proved security properties and found deep bugs across open-source libraries.

entries.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
entries.summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera.
entries.why: Factor-aware predictive learning enables precise temporal and structural control in cinematic video generation.

entries.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
entries.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated).…
entries.why: IQuest-Q1 introduces a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture designed for agentic CLI systems.

entries.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
entries.summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels.
entries.why: Policy-Mask provides budget-aware feature adaptation from diffusion models to discriminative tasks.

entries.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
entries.summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models.
entries.why: New unified multimodal approaches tackle fine-grained visual understanding of local attributes.

entries.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
entries.summary: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it.
entries.why: Cola2 explores co-adaptive hierarchical language modeling with continuous semantic compression.

entries.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
entries.summary: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection.
entries.why: Verus-Insight addresses explainable artifact detection in increasingly realistic synthetic videos.
